name: Elderwood
author: JustinH_
description:
"Nature is in danger. A foreign army has slowly taken over the forest and the surrounding area. Fulfill the role of a druid and protect this mystical forest from the invaders. Track down the mysterious general that has been haunting the school to eElderwood certainly is an unique experience.

Controls:
- 'w,a,s,d' to move around.
- Click and drag right mouse button to move the camera.
- Press '1' to channel the strenght of a bear, knocking back enemies.
- Press '2' to channel the might of a phoenix, crossing a short distance in the blink of an eye.
- Press 'Left Shift' to channel your healing ability, this only works in combat.
- Your health is visible in the top-left corner of the screen, when it reaches '0', the game is over.
- A mini-map will be at display in the bottom-left corner of the screen, showing you the interesting locations.
- Press 'Escape/Esc' to bring up a pause menu, allowing you to go to the main menu or to continue your fantasy experience.

Good luck on your journey!
